thread:
Tom (partnerships): Quick thread  we need normalized partner inputs for the marketplace cost model: reserved terms (1/3/12 mo), reserved $/GPU-hr, spot $/GPU-hr, listing fee (pct/flat + billing cadence), min commit, early-termination rules, spot preemption rate and avg reclaim notice. Please paste rows or upload to the sheet Sam will share. Deadline Fri EOD.
Asha (finops): CSV template request: partner,region,sku,billing_granularity,reserved_term_months,reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,listing_fee_type,listing_fee_value,min_commit_gpus,early_termination_fee_notes,spot_preemption_rate_pct,avg_reclaim_notice_minutes,tier_breakpoints,renewal_pricing_note
Dev (product): Call out hardware substitution policy and region availability in a note field. If partner gives blended prices, ask for effective $/GPU-hr at 10/50/200 GPUs.
Cory (legal): Also request sample contract language for spot interruption credits, and whether listing fees are refundable. Flag any auto-renew > 6mo for legal review.
Sam (partnerships): Sheet link in 10m. If partners won't share list price, request an "effective USD/GPU-hour by tier" plus a representative utilization profile (avg seq len, tokens/min) so we can simulate.
Pricing Bot: Created ticket #6731 "partner pricing inputs" assigned to Sam. Reminder set for 48h.
Asha (finops): Example internal benchmark for modelers: 12mo reserved = $1.88 / GPU-hr, spot = $0.50 / GPU-hr, listing fee = 4% rev (amortized), min_commit = 15 GPUs, avg_reclaim_notice = 8 min.
Tom (partnerships): Thanks  Sam please escalate if only partial data comes back. We'll present a sensitivity table (spot-heavy vs reserved-heavy) to GTM next Tue.
Sam (partnerships): Will follow up Tue morning.
